name: pulsewatch
description: PulseWatch - website uptime monitoring platform (dev workflow scripts)

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend"
scripts.build: cargo build --workspace && npm --prefix frontend run build
scripts.test: cargo test --workspace && npm --prefix frontend run test
scripts.lint: cargo fmt --check && cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings && npm --prefix frontend run lint
